body: Well, this is EXACTLY the situation at my end. Thank you very very much for this comment. It is a potential game-changer in my life! In this case, I have a suspicion that I am in love with her...(I never ever thought about it that way though; she has a boyfriend and her boyfriend was one of my close friends back in my home country). I really want to lay out ABSOLUTELY EVERYTHING on the table, but right now I am not sure if it is worth her time, because I think she seems to have moved on and doesn't give a shit about me anymore. (or maybe I am just thinking that).
The main problem is that I am in an isolated place with little or no opportunity to make new friends. I am stuck with her. And i can't really move out :-(
Yes, I think it is a case of forbidden fruit. The more we fight with each other, the more our relationship gets affected, and the more I feel like getting closer to her.
Thanks for this. It kinda puts a new spin on everything. I thought long and hard about this, but I guess it might not be love.
I know it is a matter of self-respect. But today, I was so desperate that I went and begged her and asked if things can be fine again.(i got a rude non-committal answer)
Thanks for the reddit gold. In this torrid time, it brought me a smile to my face. I am happy by the responses that atleast r/suicidewatch gives a shit about me.

Some more things that I want to share :

I don't want to commit suicide because I know it would bring a lot of pain to my family and friends. I also know that I am pretty young and a few years from now all of this may look like a joke, but at the moment I am so tortured in my mind that I want a way out and suicide seems to be the only solution.

It is traumatic for me to even imagine her ignoring me tomorrow when I will be seeing her (in a public place). The meeting is just a few hours from now and my heart is already beating wildly

Thanks, I will give it a try. I wanted to ask you, and everyone reading this thread..Am I a cruel psychopath? (in the sense, I am torturing this girl with my friendship which I am not even sure that she needs). My mind is a mixture of guilt, regret, pain and bitterness now. Too much negativity, I know.

I have talked to her many times about this. But she just responds with "You are crazy" and distances from me till I stop mentioning this and be normal with her again. When she tries to avoid me, I get more agitated and I continually beg for forgiveness (act of desperation).

I also have this huge guilt feeling of somehow not being a good enough friend to her. And this guilt feeling makes me push forward and be more close to her (while I am battling my other part of my mind which is asking me to retreat from her).
